title: Metrics
description: Everything livekit-agents 1.8 measures, under its own field names. The blocks are the session's metrics classes verbatim; the turn metrics are its ChatMessage report split by role; the usage rows are its per-model summary. Times are seconds unless the name says ms; timestamps are unix seconds. A field the measuring side could not fill is absent, never zero.

Metadata.description: Which model and provider produced a block. livekit's Metadata, nested exactly as it nests it.

model_name.description: The model's name as the provider plugin reports it.

model_provider.description: The provider's name as the plugin reports it: anthropic, elevenlabs, soniox.

LLMMetrics.description: One LLM request, measured by the session's llm node. Two arrive for one reply when a tool ran in between; they share the speech_id.

label.description: The node that measured: the plugin's label for its LLM.

request_id.description: The provider's id for this request, for correlating with their logs.

timestamp.description: When the request completed, unix seconds.

duration.description: The whole request, first byte sent to last token received, seconds.

ttft.description: Time to first token, seconds. -1 when the reply produced no token.

cancelled.description: True when the request was cut short, usually because the caller interrupted.

completion_tokens.description: Tokens the model wrote, reasoning included.

prompt_tokens.description: Tokens the model read, cache hits included.

prompt_cached_tokens.description: Of the prompt tokens, how many were served from the provider's cache.

cache_creation_tokens.description: Prompt tokens written into the cache on this request (Anthropic cache writes). 0 when the provider does not report it.

reasoning_tokens.description: Completion tokens spent on hidden reasoning. Already inside completion_tokens; never add it again.

total_tokens.description: prompt_tokens plus completion_tokens, as the provider counts them.

speech_id.description: The reply this request served, joining it to turn.agent. Null for a request outside a reply.

STTMetrics.description: One speech-to-text request, measured by the session's stt node. A streaming STT reports one per connection segment, with duration 0.

label.description: The node that measured: the plugin's label for its STT.

request_id.description: The provider's id for this request.

timestamp.description: When the request completed, unix seconds.

duration.description: The request's length in seconds. 0 when the STT streams, since a stream has no single request.

audio_duration.description: How much audio was pushed to the recognizer, seconds.

input_tokens.description: Audio tokens in, for providers that bill by token. 0 otherwise.

output_tokens.description: Text tokens out, for providers that bill by token. 0 otherwise.

streamed.description: True when the recognizer ran over a websocket stream rather than one request per utterance.

acquire_time.description: Seconds spent getting a connection before the audio could flow. Websocket providers only.

connection_reused.description: True when the connection came from the pool rather than a fresh handshake.

TTSMetrics.description: One text-to-speech request, measured by the session's tts node. One reply may produce several, one per sentence segment.

label.description: The node that measured: the plugin's label for its TTS.

request_id.description: The provider's id for this request.

timestamp.description: When the request completed, unix seconds.

ttfb.description: Time to first byte of audio after the text was sent, seconds.

audio_duration.description: How much audio came back, seconds of playback.

cancelled.description: True when synthesis was cut short, usually by an interruption.

characters_count.description: Characters synthesized, what character-billed providers charge for.

input_tokens.description: Text tokens in, for token-billed TTS. 0 otherwise.

output_tokens.description: Audio tokens out, for token-billed TTS. 0 otherwise.

streamed.description: True when the audio streamed back over a websocket.

acquire_time.description: Seconds spent getting a connection first. Websocket providers only.

connection_reused.description: True when the connection came from the pool.

segment_id.description: Which sentence segment of the reply this was.

speech_id.description: The reply this audio belongs to, joining it to turn.agent.

VADMetrics.description: The voice activity detector's health, reported about once a second while it runs. Not a per-turn measure.

timestamp.description: When the report was cut, unix seconds.

idle_time.description: Seconds the detector spent waiting for audio in this window.

inference_duration_total.description: Seconds spent inside the model in this window.

inference_count.description: How many frames the model scored in this window.

EOUMetrics.description: How long the session took to decide that the caller had finished. One per user turn.

timestamp.description: When the turn was closed, unix seconds.

end_of_utterance_delay.description: Seconds from the VAD hearing silence to the decision that the turn is over. 0 when no end of speech was detected.

transcription_delay.description: Seconds from the end of speech to the final transcript. 0 when no end of speech was detected.

on_user_turn_completed_delay.description: Seconds the app's on_user_turn_completed hook took.

speech_id.description: The reply this turn triggered, joining it to turn.user and turn.agent.

EOTInferenceMetrics.description: One prediction by the end-of-turn model. It listens to the audio and says whether the caller is done.

timestamp.description: When the prediction came back, unix seconds.

total_duration.description: Seconds from the earliest audio in the inference to the answer.

detection_delay.description: Seconds from the latest audio in the inference to the answer.

num_requests.description: How many requests one inference needed. Usually 1.

InterruptionMetrics.description: The interruption detector's latest inference and its running counts. Reported when the detector runs, not per turn.

timestamp.description: When the inference came back, unix seconds.

total_duration.description: Round trip of the latest inference, seconds.

prediction_duration.description: The model's own time on the latest inference, seconds.

detection_delay.description: Seconds from the onset of speech to the final prediction, latest inference.

num_interruptions.description: Interruptions detected so far in the session.

num_backchannels.description: Backchannels ('mm-hm', 'sí') detected so far and not treated as interruptions.

num_requests.description: Requests sent to the detector so far.

RealtimeCachedTokenDetails.description: Of a realtime model's cached input, how much was audio, text or image.

RealtimeInputTokenDetails.description: What a realtime model read, by kind, with the cached part broken out.

cached_tokens.description: Of all input tokens, how many came from the cache.

cached_tokens_details.description: The cached tokens by kind, when the provider breaks them out.

RealtimeOutputTokenDetails.description: What a realtime model produced, by kind.

image_tokens.description: Image tokens produced. Realtime models no longer emit these; kept because the library keeps it.

RealtimeModelMetrics.description: One response from a speech-to-speech model, which replaces STT, LLM and TTS at once. Pinecall's default pipeline never emits it; a realtime provider would.

request_id.description: The provider's id for the response.

timestamp.description: When the response was created, unix seconds.

duration.description: Seconds from response created to response done.

session_duration.description: Seconds the session connection has been open, for providers that bill by session time.

ttft.description: Seconds to the first audio token. -1 when no audio token was sent.

cancelled.description: True when the response was cut short.

input_tokens.description: Tokens read, text and audio together.

output_tokens.description: Tokens produced, text and audio together.

tokens_per_second.description: Output tokens over the response's duration.

acquire_time.description: Seconds spent getting a connection first.

connection_reused.description: True when the connection came from the pool.

AvatarMetrics.description: Timing of a video avatar worker, when one is in the chain. No Pinecall channel has one today; carried because the library measures it.

timestamp.description: When the report was cut, unix seconds.

playback_latency.description: Seconds between forwarding the first audio frame to the avatar and the avatar reporting playback.

session_started_time.description: When the avatar session started, unix seconds.

avatar_joined_time.description: When the avatar participant joined the room with its video track, unix seconds.

TurnMetadata.description: Which model handled one leg of a turn. livekit's MetricsMetadata, as it sits on the ChatMessage.

model_name.description: The model's name as the plugin reports it.

model_provider.description: The provider's name as the plugin reports it.

UserTurnMetrics.description: What the session measured about the caller's turn. livekit stamps it on the user ChatMessage; every field is optional, since a text session has no speech to time.

started_speaking_at.description: When the caller began speaking, unix seconds.

stopped_speaking_at.description: When the caller stopped speaking, unix seconds.

transcription_delay.description: Seconds from the end of speech to the final transcript.

end_of_turn_delay.description: Seconds from the end of speech to the decision that the turn was over.

on_user_turn_completed_delay.description: Seconds the app's on_user_turn_completed hook took.

UserTurnMetrics.x-measured-by: the session, on the user ChatMessage

AgentTurnMetrics.description: What the session measured about the agent's reply. livekit stamps it on the assistant ChatMessage; every field is optional, since a text session has no audio to time.

started_speaking_at.description: When the first audio frame of the reply went out, unix seconds.

stopped_speaking_at.description: When the last audio frame of the reply went out, unix seconds.

llm_node_ttft.description: Seconds until the llm node returned its first token.

llm_node_tps.description: Output tokens per second over the streaming window. Absent for a reply that arrived in one chunk.

llm_node_ttfs.description: Seconds from generation start until the first sentence reached the TTS. Absent when no audio came from a LiveKit TTS.

tts_node_ttfb.description: Seconds until the tts node returned its first audio chunk, counted from the first text token.

playback_latency.description: Seconds between forwarding the first audio frame and the output reporting playback. Near zero on a room; meaningful with an avatar.

e2e_latency.description: Seconds from the caller finishing to the agent starting to answer. The number a caller feels.

provider_request_ids.description: The provider-side request ids behind this reply, for correlating with their logs.

AgentTurnMetrics.x-measured-by: the session, on the assistant ChatMessage

LLMModelUsage.description: Everything one LLM consumed over the call. One row per provider and model, as livekit's usage collector sums it.

input_cached_tokens.description: Of the input, tokens served from cache.

input_cache_creation_tokens.description: Of the input, tokens written into the cache.

input_audio_tokens.description: Audio tokens read, multimodal models only.

input_text_tokens.description: Text tokens read, when the provider breaks input out by kind.

input_image_tokens.description: Image tokens read, multimodal models only.

output_audio_tokens.description: Audio tokens written, multimodal models only.

output_text_tokens.description: Text tokens written, when the provider breaks output out by kind.

output_reasoning_tokens.description: Tokens spent on hidden reasoning. Already inside output_tokens.

session_duration.description: Seconds of session connection, for providers that bill by session time.

TTSModelUsage.description: Everything one TTS consumed over the call.

input_tokens.description: Text tokens in, for token-billed TTS.

output_tokens.description: Audio tokens out, for token-billed TTS.

STTModelUsage.description: Everything one STT consumed over the call.

input_tokens.description: Audio tokens in, for token-billed STT.

output_tokens.description: Text tokens out, for token-billed STT.

InterruptionModelUsage.description: How often the interruption detector was asked over the call.

EOTModelUsage.description: How often the end-of-turn model was asked over the call.

total_requests.description: Inference requests sent to the model.

ModelUsage.description: One usage row, told apart by its type tag.
